payload.summary: Design revised by visualjc (overriding the create-if-absent-only restraint): an existing CLAUDE.md lacking '@AGENTS.md' gets it PREPENDED, rest of file kept — the AGENTS.md instructions are load-bearing and a hint can be missed. Precedent: init already merges the nahel section into existing AGENTS.md, so the house rule is additive/idempotent/loudly-reported edits, not never-touch. Spec: check containment anywhere in file (not just line 1, avoid duplicating a mid-file import); absent -> prepend + report; present -> kept; no file -> create with the one line. Deliberate deletions get re-added on re-install — accepted.
